privacy.title: Amụma Nzuzo
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets na-anakọta ntakịrị ozi onwe onye dị mkpa maka imepụta akaụntụ na nnweta Premium, gụnyere adreesị email na nkọwa ịkwụ ụgwọ nke a na-ahazi n'enwe nchekwa site na Stripe (web) na Google Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: Anyị na-eji ozi gị enye ohere ịnweta ntụnye ịkụ nzọ anyị, hazie ịkwụ ụgwọ, na jikwaa usoro nkwanye. Anyị anaghị ere data onwe onye gị nye ndị ọzọ.
privacy.s3Body: Anyị na-etinye usoro nchekwa ọkọlọtọ ụlọ ọrụ site na Supabase, Stripe, Google Play na RevenueCat iji chebe data gị. Otú ọ dị, ọ dịghị ụzọ mbufe ọ bụla n'ịntanetị dị 100% nchekwa.
privacy.s4Body: Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ajụjụ ọ bụla gbasara Amụma Nzuzo a, biko kpọtụrụ anyị na greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Usoro Ọrụ
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets na-enye ntụnye ịkụ nzọ na surebets maka ozi. Anyị anaghị enye ọrụ ịgba chaa chaa ma ọ bụ ndụmọdụ gbasara ego. Ọrụ ịkụ nzọ niile bụ n'ihe ize ndụ gị.
terms.s2Body: A na-enye nnweta Premium site na ndebanye aha na Android (Google Play, nke RevenueCat na-ahazi) na ịzụta otu oge na web (nke Stripe na-ahazi). Ndebanye aha Google Play dị n'okpuru amụma ịkwụ ụgwọ na nkwụghachi nke Google Play. Ịzụta na web bụ nke ikpeazụ ozugbo enyere nnweta.
terms.s3Body: Ezubere usoro ntụnye aka anyị maka ojiji onwe onye. Mmejọ, gụnyere ịkpọ onwe gị aka ma ọ bụ imepụta akaụntụ aghụghọ, ga-akpata nkwụsị akaụntụ na ịla n'iyi nke bonuses.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets anaghị ekwe nkwa mmeri. Arụmọrụ gara aga abụghị ihe na-egosi nsonaazụ ọdịnihu. Na-egwu egwu na ọrụ ọha mgbe niile.

deletion.title: Ihichapụ Akaụntụ & Data
deletion.intro: Na Great Sport Bets, anyị na-akwanyere nzuzo gị ùgwù ma nye ụzọ doro anya iji hichapụ akaụntụ gị na data onwe gị.
deletion.warningBody: Ihichapụ akaụntụ gị na-adịgide adịgide. Ị ga-efunahụ ohere ịnweta ọkwa Premium gị, bonuses ntụnye aka, na akụkọ ihe mere eme. Enweghị ike ịlaghachi azụ na omume a.
deletion.step1: Zipu email na <email>{{email}}</email> site na adreesị email ejikọtara na akaụntụ Great Sport Bets gị.
deletion.step3: A ga-ahazi arịrịọ gị n'ime ụbọchị ọrụ 7. Ị ga-enweta email nkwenye ozugbo ihichapụ ahụ mechara.
deletion.deleted2: Ndekọ ohere Premium na akụkọ ịkwụ ụgwọ
deletion.deleted3: Njikọ ntụnye aka, koodu, na akụkọ ihe mere eme
deletion.keptBody: Maka nrubeisi iwu na ego (dịka, mkpesa ụtụ maka ịkwụ ụgwọ Stripe na Google Play), anyị nwere ike idobe ID azụmahịa na metadata ruo afọ 5. Data a adịghị ejikọta na njirimara onwe gị ma ejiri ya naanị maka nyocha.
